svg.title: Connecting the agent automatically
svg.desc: 1. AgentBuff signs a short-lived ES256 assertion for the owner. 2. BYM verifies it against AgentBuff's public keys, rejects assertions older than 120 seconds and any reused token id. 3. The owner is matched by subject only, never by email. 4. BYM issues a 90 day token for the owner's main book, returns it once and stores only its hash. 5. The agent's connector initializes the MCP session and lists the tools its scope allows.
